description: High-performance Ethereum primitives, cryptography, and EVM execution library for TypeScript (@tevm/voltaire) and Zig (@tevm/zig) with WASM, Native FFI, and C99 ABI support.
rules: Use `@tevm/voltaire` for TypeScript/JavaScript imports (e.g., `import { Address } from '@tevm/voltaire/Address'` or `@tevm/voltaire`) and `@tevm/zig` for Zig.
Prefer primary constructor functions like `Address(...)`, `Hash(...)`, `Hex(...)`, and `Bytes32(...)` over `.from(...)` aliases.
Voltaire primitives are branded `Uint8Array` and `bigint` types validated at construction time with tree-shakeable namespace functions.
Use `Hardfork.DEFAULT` (`OSAKA`) and explicit hardfork parameters when working with EIP-7951 (P256VERIFY), EIP-7918/EIP-7892 blob schedules, or EIP-7934 RLP block limits.
For non-JS/Zig languages (C, Rust, Go, Python, Swift), reference the C99 ABI recipes in `docs/C_FFI_RECIPES.md`.
